title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all
body:
The list now opens on open items, with Open, Done and All views; done items are marked ✓.

**Preview:** none — local review only

## Announcement

Items can be done or open. The list shows what is still open, and you can switch to the done items or to everything.

## What you should know

- **Behaviour change:** `/` now lists only open items (it used to list every item); `/?view=done` and `/?view=all` show the others; any other `view` value answers 400. Empty views have their own message, and an empty table still says "No items yet.".
- **Decisions:** the list opens on open items; the view is a query parameter (specs/done-items.md).
- **Changed after the go:** nothing
- **Tests deleted or loosened:** none. The synthetic-traffic test's fake app now records the query string too, so a route with a query can be checked.
- **Traffic route check:** `scripts/traffic-config-check.mjs` now accepts a route with a query string (spaces and `#` are still refused), because this change adds one; `tests/traffic-config.test.sh` covers both.
- **Manual steps for you:** none

## Evidence

- **Screenshots:** none (no browser in this session)
- **Reviewer:** pending
- **CI:** not run yet
- **Low findings:** none

<details>
<summary>Engineering details</summary>

Migration `0002_add_done.sql` adds `done` (0/1, default 0), additive and backward-compatible. `src/index.js` picks the view from `view`, `test/done.test.js` covers AC-1 to AC-8 and each state, `traffic/routes.json` adds the done and all views, README describes the views.

</details>
